:::{#def-fitted-model}
#### Fitted model

A **fitted model** $\emodmem$ is a member of a [model family](#def-model-family) $\modelfam$
that has been chosen to describe a [data set](#def-data-set) $\dataset$.
A fitted model used to [predict](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) outcomes is also called a *[prediction rule]{#def-prediction-rule}*.

:::
